processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Sound portion of the 30 kg vacuum-induction-melted ingot homogenized at 1423 K for 2.5 h prior to hot rolling.
Hot rolled at 1323 K; final thickness of the hot rolled plate ~13 mm. This condition is referred to as HR.
Cold rolled to ~50% reduction in thickness (~6 mm thick sheets) by several passes; 15Mn5Ni alloy experienced cracking beyond 50% cold reduction so reduction was restricted to 50%. Denoted HR+CR.
Cold rolled sheet heat treated at 1023 K for 1 h followed by water quenching (part of the 873–1273 K / 1 h / water-quench series).

structures.overall_structure: Banded microstructure of partially recrystallized/deformed austenite (γ) with dark unindexed bands, together with abundant coarse B2 stringers aligned along the rolling direction (RD); this alloy shows the highest B2 fraction among the three alloys at 1023 K, and the KAM map indicates the highest retained stored strain of the three alloys. Secondary-phase precipitates (B2 and κ-carbide) co-precipitated along grain boundaries forming precipitate-rich zones.

phases_present.morphology: banded/elongated grains; mixed recrystallized and deformed regions, banded structure with dark unindexed bands

defects.type: retained stored strain (elevated KAM, highest of the three alloys at 1023 K)

average_grain_size.value: at or below the few-μm level

microstructure_list.region: stringer bands along RD and grain boundaries

phases_present.morphology: elongated stringers/bands aligned along RD; red FCC matrix traversed by numerous elongated blue B2 stringers/bands — highest B2 fraction of the three alloys

precipitates.distribution: along grain boundaries forming precipitate-rich zones

phases_present.morphology: coarser κ-carbides co-precipitated with B2 along grain boundaries

precipitates.distribution: co-precipitated with B2 along grain boundaries in precipitate-rich zones

defect_interactions.interaction_type: intergranular cracking / crack propagation along γ/B2 interphase boundaries
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Cross-section of the failed tensile specimen of 15Mn5Ni heat treated at 1023 K revealed intergranular cracks; OIM-IPF and phase maps clearly indicated propagation of cracks along γ/B2 interphase boundaries.

interfaces.phase_evolution: Nucleation of recrystallized grains occurs mostly along γ/γ boundaries and the γ/B2 interface; dissolution rate of fine intragranular and intergranular B2 is higher than that of B2 stringers.
interfaces.interface_notes: At 1023 K the 15Mn5Ni alloy showed much lesser recrystallization of the austenite matrix and a large volume fraction of secondary-phase precipitation along grain boundaries forming precipitate-rich zones; fracture was crack-initiation controlled.

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: flat tensile specimens, gauge length 30 mm, width 6 mm, thickness 4–5 mm
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Tensile tests conducted at a constant cross-head speed of 0.5 mm min^-1; tests triplicated per condition

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: not recorded (alloy behaved as brittle material, stress–strain curves could not be recorded)

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: ductility / fracture mode at HR+CR+1023 K

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Zeiss Supra 55 FEG-SEM equipped with EDS and Nordley EBSD detectors (Oxford); TSL-OIM software
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: step size 120 nm (fine-grained) / 250 nm (coarse-grained); area ~100×100 μm² / ~200×200 μm²; three scans per sample; GOS 2° criterion and KAM for recrystallization
characterization_methods.purpose: grain orientations, grain size, twin fractions, phase contrast maps, KAM and GOS to delineate recrystallized microstructure
characterization_methods.key_findings: In HR+CR+1023 K, 15Mn5Ni shows a banded structure with dark unindexed bands; the phase map shows a red FCC matrix traversed by numerous elongated blue B2 stringers aligned along RD (highest B2 fraction of the three alloys); the KAM map is predominantly green–yellow with dark bands (highest retained stored strain of the three alloys).

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: post-tensile fractured specimen heat treated at 1023 K
characterization_methods.purpose: to examine the fracture surface and crack path
characterization_methods.key_findings: The 15Mn5Ni specimen (HR+CR+1023 K) exhibited quasi-cleavage fracture with large numbers of microcracks; the cross-section revealed intergranular cracks propagating along γ/B2 interphase boundaries.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: AFFRI Vickers hardness tester, 30 kg (~300 N) peak load, 15 s dwell
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: ASTM E-140-02; values averaged over ten measurements on each sample
characterization_methods.purpose: to evaluate hardness variation with degree of cold work and heat treatment temperature
characterization_methods.key_findings: Hardness of heat-treated samples was measured as a function of heat treatment temperature for all three alloys (Fig. 8b); Ni-containing alloys showed higher hardness than 28Mn0Ni and hardness decreased with increasing heat treatment temperature. A specific numerical hardness value for 15Mn5Ni at HR+CR+1023 K is not reported in the text.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: room temperature; constant cross-head speed 0.5 mm min^-1 (initial strain rate ~3×10^-4 s^-1); ASTM E8M flat specimens
characterization_methods.purpose: to evaluate strength and ductility in different processing conditions
characterization_methods.key_findings: For 15Mn5Ni in HR+CR+973 K and HR+CR+1023 K the alloy behaved as a brittle material (elongation <1%) so no stress–strain curves could be recorded.

unmapped_findings: 15Mn5Ni alloy in the HR+CR+1023 K condition failed in tension in a brittle, crack-initiation-controlled manner with a quasi-cleavage fracture surface bearing many microcracks, distinct from the dimple (ductile) fracture of 28Mn0Ni and 28Mn5Ni at the same condition.
The processing temperature window for 15Mn5Ni alloy to attain an optimum strength-ductility combination was concluded to be around 1173 K, not 1023 K; at 973 K and 1023 K the alloy was brittle.

Note on internal inconsistency: block b0062 refers to 15Mn5Ni specimens heat treated at '973 K and 1073 K' displaying negligible ductility (<1%), whereas the same condition is given as 1023 K elsewhere (b0031, b0034, b0060); the 1073 K appears to be a typographical inconsistency.
